nativeRows.policy: All runtime-loaded indexed vertices and triangles use the exact before/after viewer terrain samplers. No newly wholly buried triangle is allowed. A terrain-distant component also requires >=50% of its native low rim to lie inside a lower same-parent or explicit CSUID-pinned current native or separately verified surveyed-basic dependency. All support fractions and burial thresholds unchanged.

qualification: Raw base-only flags are retained verbatim. Seven roof-only and three exact unsurveyed forms are resolved by current full ground/roof proofs, unchanged source/body fields, all-ten collision and actual atomic/browser observations; their guarded plan fragment is mandatory for this resolution. Native full-mesh rows are reused byte-for-byte.
